_comment: Shared corpus of the registry and election providers. The postgres keys (schema_placeholder, ddl, statements, transient_sqlstate_prefixes, messages, schema_command, schema_command_usage_errors) hold the DDL, every statement text ({schema} stands for the connection's schema), the schema command output, the SQLSTATE classes retried as transient and the messages. The redis section holds the key templates ({prefix}, {worker} and {scope} stand for the connection's key prefix, the sanitized worker name and the scope), the six Lua scripts, the reply codes retried as transient, the connect time limit, the messages, and one worked example with the arguments of every command (@name stands for the script of that name). Pinned so every implementation emits the same bytes.
ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS {schema}.fleet_workers (
    worker        text        PRIMARY KEY,
    instance      text        NOT NULL,
    cluster       text        NOT NULL,
    card          text        NOT NULL,
    heartbeat_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS fleet_workers_cluster_idx ON {schema}.fleet_workers (cluster)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS fleet_workers_heartbeat_idx ON {schema}.fleet_workers (heartbeat_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS {schema}.archive_locks (
    cluster       text        PRIMARY KEY,
    token         text        NOT NULL,
    worker        text        NOT NULL,
    instance      text        NOT NULL,
    acquired_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    refreshed_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
)

publish.sql: INSERT INTO {schema}.fleet_workers (worker, instance, cluster, card, heartbeat_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, now()) ON CONFLICT (worker) DO UPDATE SET instance = EXCLUDED.instance, cluster = EXCLUDED.cluster, card = EXCLUDED.card, heartbeat_at = now()

list_prune.sql: DELETE FROM {schema}.fleet_workers WHERE heartbeat_at < now() - make_interval(secs => $1)

list_select.sql: SELECT worker, card, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - heartbeat_at)::float8 FROM {schema}.fleet_workers ORDER BY worker

withdraw.sql: DELETE FROM {schema}.fleet_workers WHERE worker = $1 AND instance = $2

acquire_select.sql: SELECT token, worker, instance, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - refreshed_at)::float8 FROM {schema}.archive_locks WHERE cluster = $1 FOR UPDATE

acquire.sql: INSERT INTO {schema}.archive_locks AS held (cluster, token, worker, instance, acquired_at, refreshed_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, now(), now()) ON CONFLICT (cluster) DO UPDATE SET token = EXCLUDED.token, worker = EXCLUDED.worker, instance = EXCLUDED.instance, acquired_at = CASE WHEN held.token = EXCLUDED.token THEN held.acquired_at ELSE now() END, refreshed_at = now() WHERE held.token = EXCLUDED.token OR held.refreshed_at < now() - make_interval(secs => $5) RETURNING token

refresh.sql: UPDATE {schema}.archive_locks SET refreshed_at = now() WHERE cluster = $1 AND token = $2

is_held.sql: SELECT 1 FROM {schema}.archive_locks WHERE cluster = $1 AND token = $2

release.sql: DELETE FROM {schema}.archive_locks WHERE cluster = $1 AND token = $2

messages.missing_table: table {schema}.{table} does not exist and connections.postgres.{connection}.manage_schema is false; create it with: drakkar-schema postgres --schema={schema}

scripts.publish:
local now = redis.call('TIME')
local score = now[1] .. '.' .. string.rep('0', 6 - #now[2]) .. now[2]
redis.call('SET', KEYS[1], ARGV[1], 'PX', ARGV[2])
redis.call('ZADD', KEYS[2], score, ARGV[3])
redis.call('PEXPIRE', KEYS[2], ARGV[2])
return 1
scripts.list:
local now = redis.call('TIME')
local reply = {now[1], now[2]}
local entries = redis.call('ZRANGE', KEYS[1], '0', '-1', 'WITHSCORES')
for i = 1, #entries, 2 do
  local card = redis.call('GET', ARGV[1] .. entries[i])
  if card then
    reply[#reply + 1] = entries[i]
    reply[#reply + 1] = entries[i + 1]
    reply[#reply + 1] = card
  else
    redis.call('ZREM', KEYS[1], entries[i])
  end
end
return reply
scripts.withdraw:
local card = redis.call('GET', KEYS[1])
if card and string.find(card, ARGV[1], 1, true) then
  redis.call('DEL', KEYS[1])
  redis.call('ZREM', KEYS[2], ARGV[2])
  return 1
end
return 0
scripts.acquire:
local body = redis.call('GET', KEYS[1])
if not body then
  redis.call('SET', KEYS[1], ARGV[1], 'PX', ARGV[3])
  return 1
end
if string.find(body, ARGV[2], 1, true) then
  redis.call('PEXPIRE', KEYS[1], ARGV[3])
  return 1
end
return 0
scripts.refresh:
local body = redis.call('GET', KEYS[1])
if body and string.find(body, ARGV[1], 1, true) then
  redis.call('PEXPIRE', KEYS[1], ARGV[2])
  return 1
end
return 0
scripts.release:
local body = redis.call('GET', KEYS[1])
if body and string.find(body, ARGV[1], 1, true) then
  redis.call('DEL', KEYS[1])
  return 1
end
return 0
